prerequisites: admitted reproducible source and build recipe
pinned build dependencies, fonts and licensing
Drive writer auth with scoped permissions
Drive upload readback and A9 release linkage
scientific.do_not_claim: No new scientific PDF/PPTX generated by ordinary code commit until source recipe, QA and Drive connector are configured

branch_policy.regular_edits: tracked nonforced commits to established refs; no routine snapshot or resource branches
branch_policy.immutable_releases: annotated Git tags for accepted major milestones only, created via tag-capable provider and readback
branch_policy.snapshots: Git SHA PRE/POST; new snapshot branch only if specifically requested exception

researcher_source_gates.shared_changes: source-level check of all shared policies; any PDF regression must be separately authorized
